meta_title: Firmo — one voice note, a quote ready to send
meta_description: Say what you priced, by voice note, photo or text. You check it, then you receive a quote, a proforma or an invoice as a PDF, in your name. Your prices, our presentation.
link_expired_title: This link is no longer valid
link_expired_body: It was already used or it expired. Write "space" to Firmo to get a new one.
chat_welcome: Welcome to Firmo. Send me your sale as a voice note, a photo or a text, for example: “Quote for Mr Kodjo, gate: 12 tube bars at 18,000 F”. I prepare the quote.
chat_share_number: To start, share your number with the button below: it opens your account, with no password.
chat_contact_refused: I can only use your own number. Press "Share my number".
chat_unsupported: I read text messages, voice notes and photos. Send me your sale in one of these forms.
chat_degraded_voice: I got your voice note but couldn't add it to the draft. Your draft is kept: try again in a moment or write the key details.
chat_degraded_photo: I got your photo but couldn't read it. Your draft is kept: write me the key details and I'll add them.
chat_degraded_text: I hit a technical problem, but your draft is kept. Try again in a moment.
chat_issue_proposal: Here is the preview. Shall I issue it with its final number?
chat_issue_cancelled: All right, it stays a draft. Tell me what to change.
chat_space_link:
Your Firmo space: {url}
This link works once and expires in 10 minutes.
chat_ask_issuer_name: Under which name should this quote go out?
action_refused: This action is not possible for this document.
clause_refused: Give the clause a title and a text.
clauses_intro: Your conditions, written once, carried on your documents.
document_issue_confirm: Issue this document? Its number will be final and it can no longer be changed.
document_issue_refused: The document changed or is incomplete: look at the preview again.
document_not_issuable: Something is still missing before issuing.
document_save_refused: I could not save: check the amounts and labels.
documents_search: Search a client, a subject or a number
home_empty: No document yet: send your first sale in the conversation.
home_intro: Find, correct or download what you created in the conversation.
logo_hint: PNG or JPG; it heads your documents.
logo_refused: I could not use this image: send a PNG or a JPG.
numbering_intro: Changing the format never resets a counter.
numbering_refused: This format is not possible: letters, digits, - _ / . only.
payment_refused: This payment exceeds the balance or is incomplete.
presentation_intro: This information is carried on your next documents.
presentation_preview_after_name: The preview appears once your name is saved.
presentation_preview_alt: Preview of a document's first page with your presentation
presentation_refused: I could not save: check the name and the percentages.
profile_color_hint: It shows on your documents, never in the app.
share_ready: Send this link to your client: it opens this document only, read-only.
chat_privacy_note: Your voice notes and photos are not kept: I only keep what I read from them, in your space. Your prices serve your documents only.
chat_plan_required:
Your 3 free documents are used. To issue this one, subscribe to Firmo: {url}
The link works once and expires in 10 minutes. Then answer “yes” and I issue it.
chat_quota_reached:
You issued your 30 documents of the last 30 days. Your subscription and what comes next: {url}
The link works once and expires in 10 minutes.
chat_plans_unavailable: I cannot check your subscription right now. Your document stays ready: say “yes” again in a moment.
plan_subscribed: Firmo is active until {until}. Documents left in the current period: {remaining}.
plan_required: Your {free} free documents are used. Subscribe to issue again; your drafts stay.
plan_unavailable: Your subscription cannot be read right now. Try again in a moment.
plan_offer: The Firmo offer: {documents} issued documents per {days}-day period. Drafts, previews and corrections do not count.
plan_where_paid: Payment happens in your Compte Kete, which gathers your Kete subscriptions.
document_plan_required: Your free documents are used: subscribe to issue this one. It stays a draft.
document_quota_reached: You issued all the documents of your current period. This one stays a draft.
ops_refused: This space is for Kete operators only.
ops_refused_two_factor: Turn on two-factor authentication in your Compte Kete to enter here.
ops_reading_intro: Read an organization's issued document, for a reason. Every reading is journaled: who, when, which document, why.
chat_need_items: First tell me what to price.
chat_issue_changed: The draft changed since the preview: ask me again for the final document and I will show you the new preview.
chat_document_not_found: I cannot find that issued document. Give me its number as written on the PDF.
chat_convert_refused: This document cannot be converted: only an issued, accepted or pending quote or proforma can.
chat_edit_hint: Tell me what to change: a price, a quantity, a line to add or remove.
chat_new_document: All right, a new document. Send me your sale as a voice note or a text.
chat_undone: I put back the previous version.
chat_nothing_to_undo: There is no change to undo.
profile_payment: How to pay you (printed on your invoices)
chat_ask_payment: Shall I print on your invoices how to pay you? Give for example your mobile money number, or answer “no”.
chat_issued_forward_quote: Your quote is issued. Forward this PDF to {client}: long press on the PDF, then “Forward”.
chat_issued_forward_proforma: Your proforma is issued. Forward this PDF to {client}: long press on the PDF, then “Forward”.
chat_issued_forward_invoice: Your invoice is issued. Forward this PDF to {client}: long press on the PDF, then “Forward”.
chat_documents_list: Your latest documents: choose one, I send you its PDF again.
chat_no_documents: You have no issued document yet.
feedback_error: Your message did not go through. Try again in a moment.
landing_lead: In your messaging app, say what you priced. You check the quantities and the prices, then you receive a professional PDF in your name. Your calculation stays yours. Firmo takes care of presenting it.
landing_no_channel: No messaging channel is connected at this address.
landing_note_nothing: Nothing to install, no account to create.
landing_photo_after: — your sheet is read the same way.
landing_wa_voice: Hello Firmo. I want to try with my first quote. I am sending a voice note.
landing_wa_photo: Hello Firmo. I want to try with a photo of my paper quote.
landing_stage_label: Example conversation: a voice note, Firmo reading it back, then the quote as a PDF
landing_transcript: “Four security cameras at eighty-five thousand, one recorder at two hundred and fifty thousand, fitting and set-up one hundred and eighty thousand…”
landing_demo_note: Demonstration: the workshop, the client and the amounts are fictitious. The PDF itself really comes out of Firmo.
landing_doc_title: You already did the calculation. Look at what it becomes.
landing_doc_lead: The answer first — the work and its price — then the detail that justifies it. Your name, your colour, your terms. Firmo composes; it never signs in your place.
landing_doc_note: Take the time to inspect it: the figures line up, the totals come out right.
landing_doc_note_strong: This is the document your client receives.
landing_doc_alt: First page of a quote composed by Firmo: issuer, client, grouped lines, subtotals, VAT, total and deposit
landing_doc_caption: Demonstration quote, composed by Firmo. The workshop, the client and the amounts are fictitious.
landing_eq_title_b: You receive a document people take seriously.
landing_give_1: A voice note, a photo of your sheet, or a text.
landing_give_2: A glance to check what Firmo read.
landing_give_3: Nothing else: no app, no account, no password.
landing_get_1: A quote, a proforma or an invoice as a PDF, in your name.
landing_get_2: Your lines, your totals and your terms, aligned and exact.
landing_get_3: The file in the conversation, to forward to your client.
landing_reason_1: You see what was understood before anything leaves
landing_reason_1_body: Firmo reads every line back to you and waits for your answer. What it did not catch stays empty: it asks you, it never makes up an amount.
landing_reason_2: On the spot, while it is fresh
landing_reason_2_body: Coming out of the site, in the taxi, in front of the client. The quote is made when it is worth the most, without waiting to get home and sit down.
landing_reason_3_body: You speak as you would to someone in the workshop. The PDF arrives in your messaging app, and you forward it like any other file.
landing_never_lead: Your prices are your negotiating position.
landing_never_1: Suggest a price, a margin or a quantity.
landing_never_2: Send a document you have not seen.
landing_never_3: Write to you to chase you.
landing_never_3_why: Firmo speaks only when you speak to it.
landing_never_4_why: No average, no comparison, no resale.
landing_never_5: Keep your voice note or your photo.
landing_never_5_why: Only what was heard or read remains.
landing_offer_title: The offer, written as a quote
landing_offer_lead: You try on real documents, without paying anything. If you go on, it is less than a round trip to the cybercafé, for {days} days.
landing_offer_for: For: you, who price your own work.
landing_offer_object: Present your work as it deserves
landing_offer_l1: Your first {count} complete documents: quote, proforma or invoice.
landing_offer_l2: The reading of your voice note, your photo or your text.
landing_offer_l3: Your name, your logo, your colour and your terms on every document.
landing_offer_l4: The corrections of a draft, before you validate it.
landing_offer_plan: {documents} final documents per period of {days} days.
landing_offer_footnote: Only a new final document counts. Drafts, previews and corrections never count.
landing_offer_subscribe: When your offered documents are used, Firmo sends you the link to subscribe, in the conversation.
landing_q1: Does Firmo decide the price for me?
landing_a1: No. You give your quantities and your prices. Firmo lays them out, reads them back to you and waits for your correction or your validation.
landing_a2: When your offered documents are used, Firmo sends you a link in the conversation. You pay {price} for {days} days in your Compte Kete, then you answer “oui” and your document goes out.
landing_a3: A PDF in your name, with your lines, your totals and your terms. You check it, then you forward it yourself: Firmo never writes to your client.
landing_q4: What if I want to correct something?
landing_a4: You correct it in the conversation, by saying it or writing it. Corrections of the same draft do not count as a new document.
landing_a5: It shows you what it read before composing. You say the line again, or you write it. Nothing leaves without your agreement.
landing_final_lead: A thirty-second voice note, and you see what it gives. Your sheet works too. Nothing to install.
landing_final_note: Your voice note is not kept: only what was heard.
